watchOut: Advance rate and fuel program details are not stated on the page we read.
name: BasicBlock
summary: Non-recourse factoring for owner-operators and small fleets, with no contract, no reserve and no transaction fees.
differentiator: The lowest published ceiling among the factors that state one: a flat 2.5% or less, against 3% at HaulPay and 3.24% at Bobtail. It also states no transaction fees, so the 2.5% is the all-in cost on its own page. No contract at all, not even a trial period.

terms.rate: BasicBlock charges a flat 2.5% (or less!) per invoice
terms.recourse: Non-recourse: you're not on the hook if a broker fails to pay
terms.contract: No contract. Factor when you want. Stop when you want.
terms.otherFees: No reserves. "What we quote is what you pay."
terms.speed: Most carriers get paid within 24 hours of submitting paperwork

costModel.note: The flat 2.5% "or less" ceiling; no transaction fees stated.

bestFor: Owner-operators who want no contract and a single number.
skipIf: You need same-day funding guaranteed; the page says most carriers are paid within 24 hours.
